limitations: The render report and QI explicitly leave numerical precision and production acceptance not assessed.
No Q-N or Q-E is granted and no global case credit is assigned by this package.
The report retains source exclusions without inference; visual review does not turn the metadata audit into a strict containment or convergence claim.
The late right-side crest is visually close to the boundary; PNG review cannot determine local particle cause or state.

observations.camera_and_render: Both isometric and transverse-side panels remain framed over the native bounds through the full sequence; no contact sheet shows an obvious camera crop. This is an artifact/visual observation, not a physical proof.
observations.failure_screen: No obvious scene-wide empty frame, catastrophic explosion, gross out-of-domain cloud, or early termination was visible in the reviewed contacts/keys. Local particle-level penetration, conservation, and numerical correctness cannot be certified from PNGs.
observations.initial_state: At frame 0 the published views show the fixed grey boundary and blue fluid field in a populated, coherent initial arrangement. Metadata reports fixed=111708, fluid=67500, moving=0, floating=0; no rigid or floating-body motion is claimed.
observations.late_event: The late contacts and frame 835 retain populated fluid and the fixed boundary. A high right-side crest is visible near the late boundary, but it remains inside the rendered view; no blanked animation or premature stop was seen.
observations.mechanism: Across the 35 sheets and nine keys, the visible event is fluid/free-surface evolution against a fixed boundary: a wave/front grows, travels, reflects or redistributes, and later decays/reforms. The images do not support a moving-body or floating-body mechanism claim for this case.
observations.mid_event: The middle contacts show a broad crest and changing free-surface profile, followed by a stronger boundary-side crest and return structure. The fluid remains visually connected to the displayed domain.

scope_roles.assigned_F6_vs_actual_F3: F6 is the handoff/assigned review family; F3 is the actual physical/simulation family.
scope_roles.namespace_rule: The XMF source-plan condition digest is retained in its own namespace and is not substituted for a missing native or XMF physical-condition field.
